'''Beatrice''' is an NPC in {{Location|Black Shores}}.
==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events|Beatrice}}
==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Beatrice:''' It's said that the Chief Steward of the Black Shores once dedicated all of Tethys' computing power to simulating the development of civilizations.
:'''Beatrice:''' However, this practice pushed the System to the brink of collapse.
:{{DIcon}} ...
:'''Beatrice:''' The Stellar Navigators were amazed by Tethys' nearly otherworldly programming.
:'''Beatrice:''' Still, even such power is fragile in a world where the future is always uncertain.
:'''Beatrice:''' Preventing disasters, preserving the sparks of civilization, and monitoring the Lament—these are the duties we bear at the Black Shores, a promise we've made to humanity.
:'''Beatrice:''' If sacrifice is what's needed for a better future, then... I'll keep walking this path, carrying on the struggle until my last breath.
{{Dialogue End}}
